items.headline: Zelda: Ocarina of Time gets a full Switch 2 remake — Nov 5, 2026
items.why: The exact kind of first-party Nintendo remake hype you post about.
items.summary: Revealed at the Sept 8 Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct, this is a ground-up remake (not a remaster) with free jumping/sprint, full camera control, voiced cinematics, and ocarina input played by humming/singing into the Switch 2 mic. A live-action Zelda film and a special-edition Switch 2 console/controller were also announced alongside it.
keyFacts: Release date: November 5, 2026
Platform: Nintendo Switch 2 only
Price: $59.99
New: full camera control, voiced cutscenes, mic-based ocarina play
Also announced: live-action Zelda film (Apr 30, 2027), special-edition Switch 2 console (Oct 29)

items.headline: New Metroid AND new Kirby both announced in one Direct
items.why: Two of your core Nintendo franchises get fresh entries.
items.summary: Metroid Ravenous is a brand-new 2D side-scrolling Metroid entry. Kirby and the World Beyond is a 3D platformer marking Kirby's 35th anniversary. Both revealed back-to-back at the Sept 9 Nintendo Direct. Nintendo also confirmed the Kirby Air Riders amiibo line closes out with a final wave (Sword Kirby & Dragoon, Noir Dedede & Hydra) shipping in 2027.
keyFacts: Metroid Ravenous: 2D, launches January 28, 2027
Kirby and the World Beyond: 3D platformer, launches spring 2027 (Kirby's 35th anniversary)
Kirby Air Riders' final amiibo wave revealed — set closes at 7 figures total

items.headline: NEW: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave announced — a new mainline tactics RPG, Sept 17, 2026
items.why: Fresh since this morning — a brand-new Fire Emblem is dropping in 4 days, and tactics RPGs sit right in your genre lane.
items.summary: Nintendo confirmed a new mainline Fire Emblem entry with a surprisingly close release date. Box art and pricing have been revealed alongside the announcement.
keyFacts: Release date: September 17, 2026 (this week)
Genre: mainline tactics RPG
Platform: Nintendo Switch / Switch 2

items.headline: Mario Kart World's biggest free update yet — 10 retro SNES tracks, bigger online rooms
items.why: Mario Kart World is already in your library; free content beats a paywall.
items.summary: The v1.8.0 update (Sept 9) adds 10 tracks reimagined from the original Super Mario Kart (Choco Island, Vanilla Lake, Ghost Valley, and more) into VS mode, two new Knockout Tour routes, and a new Spectator Mode. Follow-up details confirmed online rooms now hold up to 26 players.
keyFacts: Update version: v1.8.0, live now — free, no purchase required
10 retro SNES-era tracks added to VS mode
New: Spectator Mode, 2 new Knockout Tour routes
Online rooms expanded to up to 26 players

items.headline: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 – Switch 2 Edition confirmed for Dec 3, 2026
items.why: Xenoblade is on your radar — this is a big upgrade, not just a port.
items.summary: 4K/60fps, fully voiced cutscenes, a new wave-battle mode ('Heroes' Vault'), and a new hero named Shimmer. $9.99 upgrade for existing owners. Monster Hunter Wilds also got a Switch 2 date the same week (Dec 4), with free future updates and wireless local play — a good week for Switch 2 upgrades generally.
keyFacts: Release date: December 3, 2026
4K/60fps on Switch 2, fully voiced cutscenes
New mode: Heroes' Vault (wave battles) + new hero Shimmer
Upgrade price for existing owners: $9.99
Also this week: Monster Hunter Wilds dated for Switch 2, Dec 4, 2026

items.headline: NEW: Switch 2 firmware v23.0.0 adds docked VRR + an eShop sale is live through Sept 26
items.why: Practical, actionable Switch 2 news — a performance upgrade and a real chance to save money right now.
items.summary: System update v23.0.0 brings Variable Refresh Rate to docked/TV mode (previously handheld-only), plus full system-to-system data transfer for Switch 2-to-Switch 2. Separately, Nintendo's eShop 'Customer Appreciation' sale is live now through Sept 26, with discounts up to 30% off.
keyFacts: Firmware v23.0.0: docked TV VRR support (new), full data transfer between two Switch 2 units
eShop sale: live Sept 12–26, 2026, up to 30% off
VRR currently only confirmed working in the Welcome Tour app

items.headline: The FFVII Remake trilogy finale finally has a name and date: Final Fantasy VII Revelation, April 8, 2027
items.why: Your personal flagship series — and it's launching day-one on every platform, not PS5-timed-exclusive.
items.summary: Announced at PlayStation's Sept 3 State of Play. Simultaneous release on PS5, Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC. The Collector's Edition reveal also confirmed a Story Expansion Pass with two post-launch DLCs: one Sephiroth-focused, one centered on Vincent & the Turks.
keyFacts: Official title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation
Release date: April 8, 2027
Platforms: PS5, Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, PC — all day one
Story Expansion Pass (Sephiroth DLC, then Vincent & the Turks DLC): Winter 2027–Spring 2028
A Trilogy Edition bundling Remake Intergrade + Rebirth is available for pre-order

items.headline: Director confirms Midgar in Revelation won't be the fully explorable Remake version
items.why: Directly answers the linear-vs-open-world / explorable-Midgar question you've been posting about.
items.summary: In interviews around the reveal, director Naoki Hamaguchi confirmed players do revisit Midgar — recreating the original game's late-story Mako Cannon raid moment — but it's been streamlined/scaled down from Remake's sprawling, corridor-heavy version to fit inside a planet-spanning open world. You'll traverse that world via the airship Highwind, which can be flown with no invisible walls. Hamaguchi also said the team is trimming some of Rebirth's minigame/content bloat in response to fan feedback.
keyFacts: Midgar returns but is NOT the fully open, walkable city from Remake — it's condensed
World traversal: airship Highwind, no invisible walls, full planet loop
Team is deliberately trimming minigame/busywork bloat vs. Rebirth
Comes from director Naoki Hamaguchi's post-reveal interviews (early-mid Sept 2026)

items.headline: NEW: Pokémon Champions update 1.2.0 adds 6 new Mega Evolutions
items.why: Pokémon is one of your core Nintendo interests, and this is a meaty content drop, not a minor patch.
items.summary: Regulation Set M-C is live, adding 6 new Mega Evolutions and 24 more battle-ready Pokémon, plus quality-of-life improvements to the battle log and team-selection UI.
keyFacts: Update: v1.2.0 / Regulation Set M-C, live now
Adds: 6 new Mega Evolutions, 24 more battle-ready Pokémon
Also: battle log and team-selection UI improvements

items.headline: Astro Bot's free DLC adds Stellar Blade's Eve and a Helldiver as rescuable bots
items.why: Feel-good platformer + GOTY/awards-culture crossover, right in your lane.
items.summary: A free content drop adds 5 new online speedrun levels and 10 rescuable bots, including guest cameos styled after Stellar Blade's Eve and a Helldivers 2 Helldiver. Team Asobi's studio head was asked directly why Square Enix characters like Cloud haven't shown up and gave a non-answer — a small irony worth noting for an FFVII fan.
keyFacts: Free DLC — already live, no purchase needed
Adds: 5 online speedrun levels, 10 new rescuable guest bots
Guest cameos: Stellar Blade's Eve, a Helldivers 2 Helldiver
No Square Enix/Cloud cameo yet, despite fan requests
